WITH customer_totals AS (
  SELECT CustomerId,
         SUM(Total) as customer_total
  FROM Invoice
  GROUP BY CustomerId
),
total_revenue AS (
  SELECT SUM(customer_total) as total_rev 
  FROM customer_totals
),
customer_shares AS (
  SELECT customer_total,
         customer_total / (SELECT total_rev FROM total_revenue) as share
  FROM customer_totals
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT customer_total, share
  FROM customer_shares
  WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM customer_shares)
)
SELECT 
  AVG(customer_total) as avg_amount_spent,
  AVG(share) as avg_share_above_avg,
  AVG(share) - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM customer_shares) as avg_beat_vs_overall_avg
FROM above_average
